title: The Hedge Maze
text: A hedge maze in the middle of nowhere, perfectly kept, its walls trimmed square and dark green and taller than a horse. No gardener in sight. At its heart, by the way the hedges lean inward, something worth finding, and something that does not want to be found.

options.label: The cleverest leads the way through.

outcomes.text: Straight to the heart, and a fountain with coins in it, and no gardener.
The maze changes behind you, quietly, and keeps changing.

options.label: The strongest cuts straight through the hedges.

outcomes.text: The hedges bleed red sap, and the gardener is very upset.
It is a very big maze, and it seems to get bigger as you walk.
